'''Clan Ojia''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[clan]]. After the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] was purchased by the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]], Clan Ojia was one of the lesser clans allowed to settle in the first wave of colonization. Notable members included [[Torel Fey'jia]], an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] in contact with [[Borsk Fey'lya]].
